checklist_items.title: Angular Setup và CLI
checklist_items.description: Cài Angular CLI, ng new, project structure, ng serve/build/test/generate, workspace config (angular.json)
checklist_items.market_relevance: Angular CLI là công cụ cốt lõi để làm việc với Angular

checklist_items.title: TypeScript cho Angular
checklist_items.description: Decorators, generics, interfaces, enums, strict mode, utility types (Partial, Required, Pick), type guards, readonly
checklist_items.market_relevance: Angular dùng TypeScript — phải biết TypeScript trước

checklist_items.title: Components và Templates
checklist_items.description: @Component decorator, selector, template/templateUrl, styles/styleUrls, standalone:true, template syntax (binding, directives), host element
checklist_items.market_relevance: Components là building block cơ bản của Angular app

checklist_items.title: Dependency Injection
checklist_items.description: @Injectable, providedIn options (root/any/platform), inject() function, InjectionToken, useValue/useClass/useFactory providers, hierarchical DI
checklist_items.market_relevance: DI là trụ cột của Angular architecture

checklist_items.title: Built-in Directives và Pipes
checklist_items.description: *ngIf/@if, *ngFor/@for, *ngSwitch/@switch, ngClass, ngStyle, AsyncPipe, DatePipe, CurrencyPipe, DecimalPipe, custom pipes
checklist_items.market_relevance: Directives và pipes dùng hằng ngày trong Angular templates

checklist_items.title: Component Lifecycle Hooks
checklist_items.description: ngOnInit, ngOnChanges (SimpleChanges), ngOnDestroy, ngAfterViewInit, ngAfterContentInit, @ViewChild, @ContentChild
checklist_items.market_relevance: Lifecycle hooks thiết yếu cho data fetching và cleanup

checklist_items.title: RxJS Fundamentals cho Angular
checklist_items.description: Observable, Subject, BehaviorSubject, operators (map, filter, switchMap, mergeMap, combineLatest, debounceTime), pipe(), error handling
checklist_items.market_relevance: RxJS là core của Angular — phải thành thạo

checklist_items.title: Angular Signals (Angular 16+)
checklist_items.description: signal(), computed(), effect(), input signal, output signal, toSignal()/toObservable(), model signal, fine-grained reactivity
checklist_items.market_relevance: Signals là future của Angular reactivity

checklist_items.title: Angular Router
checklist_items.description: Routes config, RouterLink, useRouter/ActivatedRoute, lazy loading (loadComponent/loadChildren), guards (canActivate/canDeactivate/canMatch), Resolve, route params
checklist_items.market_relevance: Router là bắt buộc cho mọi multi-page Angular app

checklist_items.title: Angular Forms — Reactive Forms
checklist_items.description: FormBuilder, FormGroup, FormControl, FormArray, Validators, custom validators, async validators, cross-field validation, updateOn, error display patterns
checklist_items.market_relevance: Reactive Forms là chuẩn cho enterprise Angular forms

checklist_items.title: HttpClient và Interceptors
checklist_items.description: HttpClient methods, TypeScript generics, HttpInterceptorFn, auth headers, error handling, retry, HttpTestingController, withInterceptors
checklist_items.market_relevance: HTTP là foundation của data-driven Angular apps

checklist_items.title: Change Detection và Performance
checklist_items.description: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, ChangeDetectorRef, markForCheck/detectChanges, async pipe, trackBy, NgZone, Signals zoneless
checklist_items.market_relevance: Change Detection là chìa khóa tối ưu Angular performance

checklist_items.title: Angular Testing
checklist_items.description: TestBed, ComponentFixture, jasmine/Jest, HttpTestingController, mock services, fakeAsync/tick, async/await tests, ng test coverage
checklist_items.market_relevance: Testing là bắt buộc trong enterprise Angular projects

checklist_items.title: Standalone Components Migration
checklist_items.description: Migrate từ NgModules sang Standalone, ng generate @angular/core:standalone schematic, imports array, bootstrapApplication
checklist_items.market_relevance: Angular 17+ recommend standalone — phải biết cách migrate

checklist_items.title: @defer Deferred Loading (Angular 17+)
checklist_items.description: @defer trigger options (on viewport/idle/interaction), @loading/@placeholder/@error blocks, prefetch, lazy loading components declaratively
checklist_items.market_relevance: @defer là game-changer cho Angular performance

checklist_items.title: State Management — NgRx
checklist_items.description: Actions, Reducers, Store, Selectors, Effects, createFeature, ComponentStore, NgRx Signals Store, devtools
checklist_items.market_relevance: NgRx là state management chuẩn cho large Angular apps

checklist_items.title: Angular SSR với Angular Universal
checklist_items.description: ng add @angular/ssr, isPlatformBrowser, TransferState, server-side rendering gotchas, deployment trên Node.js, prerendering
checklist_items.market_relevance: SSR thiết yếu cho SEO-critical Angular applications

checklist_items.title: Angular Security
checklist_items.description: DomSanitizer, XSS prevention, CSP, CSRF với XSRF-TOKEN, HttpOnly cookies, Trusted Types, dependency audit, npm audit
checklist_items.market_relevance: Security là priority cho enterprise Angular apps

checklist_items.title: Micro-Frontend với Module Federation
checklist_items.description: @angular-architects/module-federation, host/remote config, shared dependencies, cross-MFE routing, CSS isolation, authentication
checklist_items.market_relevance: Micro-frontend là architecture phổ biến trong enterprise

checklist_items.title: CI/CD và Deployment
checklist_items.description: GitHub Actions/GitLab CI pipeline, ng build production, Docker multi-stage, NGINX config, environment configs, cache busting, Blue-green deployment
checklist_items.market_relevance: CI/CD là kỹ năng bắt buộc cho senior developer
